summary.en: The Burkina Faso junta has reinstated the death penalty for terrorism, treason and high crimes, while its army and Russian mercenaries face fresh accusations of civilian killings. In Nigeria, 600 soldiers are being sent to India for specialised training and militants killed 14 security personnel in an attack on a base. In Niger, two European women were freed after more than a year of captivity and gunmen attacked buses in the north, killing at least twelve people. Mali’s army and Russian fighters are again accused of new civilian abuses. The conflict produced 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Burkina Fasos militærjunta har gjeninnført dødsstraff for terrorisme, landsforræderi og alvorlige forbrytelser, mens hæren og russiske leiesoldater står overfor nye anklager om drap på sivile. I Nigeria blir 600 soldater sendt til India for spesialisert trening, og militante drepte 14 sikkerhetspersonell i et angrep på en base. I Niger ble to europeiske kvinner løslatt etter mer enn ett år i fangenskap, og væpnede menn angrep busser i nord og drepte minst tolv personer. Mali-hæren og russiske krigere blir igjen anklaget for nye overgrep mot sivile. Konflikten førte til 4 159 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: War in the Sahel
background.extract: The War in the Sahel, also known synonymously as the Sahel War is a multi-sided armed conflict that has been ongoing since 2012. In particular, the intensive conflict mainly takes place in the three countries of Mali, Niger and Burkina Faso.
